name: hCode Teklif Yönetimi
author: halilizlemek

sections.description:
hCode Teklif Yönetimi helps WordPress and WooCommerce site owners create professional proposals, send approval links to customers, track status changes, and convert approved proposals into WooCommerce orders.

Key Features

  • Create and manage proposals from the WordPress admin area
  • Search WooCommerce products and add them as proposal items
  • Add custom products and service lines
  • Send proposal approval links to customers
  • Approve or reject proposals from a customer-facing page
  • Optionally create a WooCommerce order after approval
  • Basic reporting, logs, and CSV export
  • Translation-ready interface

Notes

  • WooCommerce is recommended for product search, customer data, and order conversion features.
  • PDF generation runs in the browser.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/hcode-teklif-yonetimi directory.
  2. Activate the plugin from the WordPress admin area.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is active if you want product and order integration.
  4. Configure the plugin from the Teklifler menu.
sections.faq:
Is WooCommerce required?

No. Basic proposal management works without WooCommerce, but WooCommerce is recommended for product search, customer data, account integration, and order creation.

Which currencies are supported?

The plugin works with TRY, USD, and EUR by default and can follow the active WooCommerce currency in supported currency switcher setups.

How do customers approve proposals?

Customers can use the approval link sent to them or the proposal screen inside the WooCommerce My Account area.
